scope: Native macOS ARM64 headless FreeCAD Draft layer qualification for the local eleven-patch mesh importer candidate.
sourceBase: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e plus eleven ordered local importer patches.
setup: Install PySide6-Essentials 6.12.0, shiboken6 6.12.0 and typing_extensions 4.16.0 into a temporary directory.
Move only the temporary wheel's PySide6/Qt/lib directory aside so the already installed matching Homebrew Qt 6.12.0 frameworks resolve; keep the wheel contents available separately.

Generate Draft_rc.py from the same FreeCAD source Draft.qrc using Homebrew Qt 6.12 rcc -g python. Add the temporary package directory, FreeCAD Draft source and FreeCAD src/3rdParty directories via the probe's task-specific environment variables.
Verify dyld reports exactly one loaded QtCore framework, from /opt/homebrew; do not treat matching version strings alone as proof of a single runtime.

validation.fixtureFree: The committed probe creates DXF controls locally in a temporary directory and deletes them. Real Draft layer objects group a bounded POLYFACE and polygon mesh under MESH and the following LINE under layer 0; a mixed child layer and a nondefault mesh layer inside a block are explicitly refused.
validation.independentGenerated: Separately ezdxf-generated direct drawings show identical grouping, 6/12 square-millimetre areas and mixed-layer refusals. Generated nested inch and millimetre drawings both report the block-layer refusal.

limits: This is real Draft layer construction in a BUILD_GUI=OFF headless process; it does not qualify GUI visibility, color appearance, native producer interpretation or other operating systems.
The block nondefault layer is refused rather than preserved; mixed layers and other unsupported styles remain open.
No drawing or third-party wheel is committed; no phase gate or external-only support claim is promoted.
